art/batch/scenes/species/aven-pc.png
Hazy desert glare creates pale gold reflected sand light and long violet shadows, a visibly hot, hazy desert atmosphere with blue-green canal reflections. Figures are strung along an implied diagonal from the lower-left corner toward the upper-right, using unequal clusters with a generous quiet gap between them. The camera is a wide establishing shot from high ground. On the far horizon a lich's green storm is gathering, ominous but distant. In one sandy patch beside the lower-left canal bank, vivid red blood is soaking into the sand; that is the only gore. A smith mends a stranger's broken blade in a small warmth moment off to the right.

The Aven community inhabits a desert city of sandstone pyramids and canals. Adult bird-headed aven have clear hawk and ibis head anatomy, mature expressive eyes, feathered heads, adult bodies, and practical scholar or messenger clothing. Seen tiny within the vast city, a few scholars gather along the lower-left ledge while winged messengers fly toward the upper-right terraces, establishing the diagonal composition. The central gap keeps the diagonal implied without filling the quiet middle with people. Broad stepped sandstone roofs, triangular pyramids and turquoise canal basins define the place. The small smith and adult stranger stand at a right-side terrace workbench, the smith repairing an actual broken blade with purposeful tools. Only the green storm appears as the lich's threat on the far horizon; do not invent a close lich or an attacking army. Keep all visible blood in the single patch soaking into sand.

Bright storm light: dark storm clouds tear open outside, and strong shafts of sunlight pour into the lodge through its broad windows and damaged roof, illuminating wet emerald forest and warm honey-colored timber. A dense crowd fills the left half of the frame while the other half is quiet empty space. Use a close medium shot on the crowded side. An ogre war band crosses a far ridge glimpsed through a side window, tiny and distant. One fallen adult warrior lies with arrows in the back, the sole bloody injury. Small and to one side, an adult places flowers on fallen bodies: the arrow-struck warrior and one fully covered adult form beside them; no visible injury or blood on the second body.

The Bugbear community: tall furry adult bugbears in a forest hunting lodge, stalking quietly, one lying wounded in a hammock, another carving a club. The dense left-side gathering has varied mature furry faces, adult proportions, purposeful hunting clothes and grief-stricken alert expressions; one nearby bugbear carves a wooden club, another keeps a quiet low stalking posture at the window. A wounded adult rests in the hammock with clean bandages, no exposed wound or added blood. The arrows and blood belong only to the fallen adult warrior beside the small flower-laying encounter, kept away from faces. The distant ogres remain on their far ridge beyond the lodge, never enlarged into foreground attackers. Keep the entire inhabited setting inside the lodge.

art/batch/scenes/species/changeling-pc.png
Bright misty morning fills the market with pale silver haze that softens the distance and delicate mint-and-peach reflected light. The composition is a wide panorama with tiny figures, the place dominating. The camera looks through a broken doorway or window. A huge unseen thing casts a shadow across part of the marketplace, but its body remains out of frame. One shattered shield is smeared vivid red, the sole gore. Two adult lovers say goodbye in a small warmth moment at the far left side.

The Changeling community: shapeshifting adult changelings at a market, faces mid-shift between disguises, masks displayed on stalls, pale smooth true forms. Let the ruined market square and its varied stall roofs dominate the panoramic view beyond a damaged stone shop doorway. Only a few tiny adult vendors and visitors appear, some pale smooth adult true forms and others with a subtle halfway shift in facial contour or hair color, each retaining one coherent anatomically sound head without extra faces, mouths or eyes. Carved masks hang from the stalls as actual blank uninscribed objects. The huge shadow passes over a far roof and side wall, not the whole bright square. The broken red-smeared shield lies by a side stall. The tiny adult lovers hold each other's hands as one turns away, grief clear in their gesture. No extra crowd is added.

loose energetic hand-drawn sketch illustration (ink lines, flat textured color, hard shadows, expressive cartoon faces), bright and colorful environment, bloody gore and despair
Loose, energetic hand-drawn digital sketch illustration with confident black ink lines with some visible rough construction strokes, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions and very expressive faces, flat color fills with dry-brush and pencil texture, hard-edged cel shadows with thin red-brown accent strokes in the shading, like one finished frame of modern Western animation concept art (a single illustration, no turnaround, no model sheet, no labels). Not anime, not Studio Ghibli, not painterly realism.

One 2400x1344 landscape desktop-background illustration. Maintain wide panoramic distance; figures are tiny and architecture dominates. Keep the middle third low in detail and free of faces through a broad open stretch of pale mint wet paving softened by morning haze, with no stalls in that central interval. Detailed stalls sit asymmetrically at either side, the farewell at far left and the single shield at far right. The doorway frame is offset and broken rather than forming a symmetrical tunnel. Figures and key details stay within the middle 80 percent of the height. All four outer edges fade softly into loose brush strokes on light cream paper.

Every person is an adult, including changeling true forms, disguises and the two lovers. The shield, shadow and goodbye carry grief, despair and the wounds of a threatened world, set against a bright, vivid and colorful market painted with the same flat textured fills as the people. Silver morning haze has mint, peach and blue reflections, never a dark, gloomy, grey or orange-only environment. Blood is vivid red and confined to the one shattered shield; no bodily wounds, blood splatter or extra gore elsewhere. The lovers' warmth moment stays small and to one side. Only the named huge off-frame presence is a threat, shown exclusively by its shadow with no enemy body or extra attackers.

Clear light just after rain reveals wet sparkling highlights on giant leaves and mushroom caps, with a natural rainbow over the glade. Adult figures are strung along an implied diagonal from the lower-left side to the upper-right, with open space between the side clusters. The camera is a close view through tall grass and reeds. A cursed beast lies dead and rotting beside the glade. A broken blade is stuck in this same fallen beast's body, keeping all death, decay and vivid-red gore together in one place. Small to the left side, two adult strangers share bread, the warmth moment.

The Fairy community: tiny winged adult fairies in a giant mushroom and flower glade, tending a wounded dragonfly and gathering dew in bluebells for the hurt. Each fairy looks unmistakably adult despite tiny scale: mature adult facial structure, wrinkles or a beard where appropriate, and adult proportions, never baby-faced. A few adult attendants form a diagonal across side leaves and stems: one tends a natural dragonfly with a clean wing dressing, others collect dew in bluebell cups. The dragonfly remains natural and noble, without visible blood. Allow only these people and actions that fit the diagonal arrangement. The cursed beast's fallen body lies at the upper-right side of the glade, original and terrifying even in death, with its rotting hide and broken blade localized to this one corpse; no other fallen body appears. The adult strangers share a simple piece of bread near the lower-left side group. Grass and reed silhouettes frame the close viewpoint without filling the whole image.

Card faces stay blank unless the Subject names one simple picture for the card, and even then no letters or numbers.

- Specific story details, never filler decoration. Varied faces, ages, bodies and clothes. Natural anatomy and hands.
- AI slop to avoid: random ribbons, flowers or bows added for no reason; a generic glowing star or orb as the whole idea; mushy or blurry details; broken anatomy; extra fingers; warped perspective; copy-paste duplicates; meaningless ornament; plastic skin; text-like squiggles; bland stock composition.
Never include:
Text, letters, numbers, runes that look like writing, logos, watermarks, signatures or artist marks, photorealism, 3D render look, lens flare, chromatic aberration, neon or fluorescent colors (vivid natural color is wanted), user-interface overlays (the UI props requested in a batch are allowed), copies of existing film characters or scenes, or of known card and book art (Magic: The Gathering, official D&D art). Clock, watch and compass faces, dice faces, book pages, scrolls, parchment, paper sheets, notes, ledgers, letters, maps, charts, signs, banners and speech bubbles stay blank: no numbers, letters or symbols on them. When the Subject names simple pictures for a sign, banner or map (a dragon shape, a pictured shop sign, an illustrated map), draw only those pictures, never letters or writing-like marks. Card faces stay blank unless the Subject names one simple picture for the card, and even then no letters or numbers.

The Githyanki community: adult githyanki warriors with silver swords ride red dragons around an astral fortress and train among floating rocks in a starry silver void. The shattered foreground doorway opens onto a wide panoramic fortress view, its terraces and nearby floating rocks far larger than all people. Tiny adult githyanki have mature angular yellow-green faces, pointed ears and adult proportions. Only a few train with plain silver swords on a side terrace; a couple of tiny allied red-dragon riders pass calmly around distant rocks. The red dragons are original imposing mounts with terrifying sharp silhouettes, not enemy attackers, and there is no blood on them or swords. On the near right terrace, still tiny in the panorama, an adult githyanki healer holds the dying adult's hand. The healer's apron and forearms carry someone else's blood; the dying person's own wound is hidden beneath a clean blanket. No added casualties, attackers or visible wounds elsewhere.

loose energetic hand-drawn sketch illustration (ink lines, flat textured color, hard shadows, expressive cartoon faces), bright and colorful environment, bloody gore and despair

One 2400x1344 landscape desktop-background illustration. Keep the broken doorway frame offset, the moon large above one side of the fortress and all people tiny at wide panoramic distance. The middle third stays low in detail and free of faces through a broad unadorned pearl-blue fortress parapet and soft silver-blue astral radiance beyond it. Detailed towers, riders and training occupy the sides; the small healer encounter sits at far right. This place is an astral fortress and starry silver void, with no terrestrial meadow, road or sky substituted for the quiet area. Figures, moon and key details stay inside the middle 80 percent of the height. All four outer edges fade softly into loose brush strokes on light cream paper. All visible faces and entire heads must remain inside the extreme outer quarter on either side, leaving the central half of the canvas completely free of all heads and faces. Give this quiet central surface clear visual priority.

Loose, energetic hand-drawn digital sketch illustration with confident black ink lines with some visible rough construction strokes, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions and very expressive faces, flat color fills with dry-brush and pencil texture, hard-edged cel shadows with thin red-brown accent strokes in the shading, like one finished frame of modern Western animation concept art (a single illustration, no turnaround, no model sheet, no labels). Not anime, not Studio Ghibli, not painterly realism.

Every person is an adult, including all tiny riders, trainees, the healer and dying person. Show grief, bodily and emotional wounds and despair through the aftermath, without any enemy in sight. The astral environment is bright, vivid and colorful in flat textured fills matching the figures: luminous silver-blue moonlight, lavender radiance, teal fortress accents and naturally red allied dragons, never dark, gloomy, grey or orange-only. Blood is vivid red and confined to the healer's apron and forearms as someone else's blood; no extra splatter or gore elsewhere. The healer holding a dying person's hand is small and to one side. There are no enemies; the named red dragons are clearly allied community mounts and no attackers appear.

All textiles, hanging cloths, flags, banners, sails, awnings and blankets are plain and completely blank: no symbols, emblems, pictures, writing or decorative marks. Weapons, tools and architecture have no inscriptions.

Quality:
WOW at first glance: striking, full of character and vivid color, with clear silhouettes, confident gesture and composition.
Specific story details, never filler decoration. Varied faces, ages, bodies and clothes. Natural anatomy and hands.
AI slop to avoid: random ribbons, flowers or bows added for no reason; a generic glowing star or orb as the whole idea; mushy or blurry details; broken anatomy; extra fingers; warped perspective; copy-paste duplicates; meaningless ornament; plastic skin; text-like squiggles; bland stock composition.

Never include:
Text, letters, numbers, runes that look like writing, logos, watermarks, signatures or artist marks, photorealism, 3D render look, lens flare, chromatic aberration, neon or fluorescent colors (vivid natural color is wanted), user-interface overlays (the UI props requested in a batch are allowed), copies of existing film characters or scenes, or of known card and book art (Magic: The Gathering, official D&D art). Clock, watch and compass faces, dice faces, book pages, scrolls, parchment, paper sheets, notes, ledgers, letters, maps, charts, signs, banners and speech bubbles stay blank: no numbers, letters or symbols on them. When the Subject names simple pictures for a sign, banner or map (a dragon shape, a pictured shop sign, an illustrated map), draw only those pictures, never letters or writing-like marks. Card faces stay blank unless the Subject names one simple picture for the card, and even then no letters or numbers.
Desktop reading-area priority: the central half of the canvas is ONE broad unoccupied smooth physical surface in this exact place, shown in large simple low-contrast flat color planes. No figures, heads, faces, small objects, inscriptions, symbols, scattered debris, repeated tiles, tiny cracks, mortar lines or intricate texture enter that central half. Every entire head stays inside an outer side quarter. Keep all detailed activity, threat and warmth to the sides.
Omit every optional flag, banner, standard, streamer, pennant and flag pole from the entire scene. No emblems, crests, insignia, sigils, symbols or writing on clothing, walls, weapons or objects. Plain functional clothing fasteners are simple unmarked shapes.
